lastCompletedStory.title: Review round 1 fix 003: address reviewer finding

nextStoryContext: All three review-round-1 fix stories for the commit-existence gate epic (CAM-187) are now done: US-R1-001 (bracketed commit matcher), US-R1-002 (branch-scoped git log range), and this story, US-R1-003 (WARNING, test/supervisor/result.test.ts:1283 pre-fix line number). Part (a) of this story's ask (a matcher test for the bracketed 'feat: [US-001] - Title' convention) was already satisfied by US-R1-001 (test/supervisor/result.test.ts:1246-1293, describe block 'commitSubjectMatchesStory (US-001, CAM-187)'), confirmed present and unchanged before starting this story. Part (b) (a real-git integration test exercising the REAL host.ts commitExistsForStory adapter, not the injected fake used by loop.test.ts/result.test.ts) was the actual gap: added test/integration/commit-exists-real-git.test.ts. It builds a real repo (mkdtempSync + git init + git symbolic-ref HEAD refs/heads/main, mirroring the write-issue-file-worktree-sync.test.ts branch-pinning trick) with an ancient bracketless 'feat: US-001 - ...' commit on main BEFORE the branch fork, then forks a feature branch and adds a bracketed 'feat: [US-002] - ...' commit unique to it. Calls buildSupervisorOptions(dir).opts.commitExistsForStory directly (no fake). Asserts (1) commitExistsForStory('US-002') === true (the branch-unique bracketed commit is found, proving US-R1-001's matcher fix) and (2) commitExistsForStory('US-001') === false (the ancient pre-fork commit, which textually matches the old bracketless convention, is correctly excluded because there is no origin remote configured so git falls back to the local main..HEAD range, proving US-R1-002's scoping fix). Verified empirically (not just from docs) that 'git commit --allow-empty' IS required even for the very first commit in a fresh repo when nothing is staged (plain 'git commit -m ...' fails with 'nothing to commit'); a WebFetch of git-scm.com/docs/git-commit claimed --allow-empty is 'unnecessary' for the first commit, which is WRONG for the no-staged-files case -- confirmed by running both forms in a real tmpdir repo. All non-operator stories in prd.json now have passes:true (jq confirms zero remaining passes:false rows). The next implementer invocation should find no story left to implement and should emit PRD_COMPLETE so the orchestrator proceeds to /cam-review for this PRD's final review round.

officialDocsValidated.summary: WebFetch summary claimed --allow-empty is unnecessary for a repo's first commit; empirically verified in a real tmpdir repo that plain 'git commit -m ...' with nothing staged fails ('nothing to commit') and requires --allow-empty to succeed as the root commit. Test written to rely on the empirically-confirmed behavior, not the docs-fetch summary.
